name: SpiralHookV2 spot-price borrow with tx.origin same-block guard
summary: SpiralHookV2.borrow values SPIRAL collateral at the live Uniswap V4 slot0 price of its own pool, and its only same-block defence keys lastSwapBlockOf on tx.origin. The attacker pumped the pool with 54 ETH from one EOA, then borrowed against the bought SPIRAL at the inflated spot from six other EOAs through one contract in the same block, withdrawing 64.71 ETH of hook-owned liquidity.

loss.notes: Net loss: the attacker's 54 ETH pump went into the same hook-owned liquidity that the borrows withdrew, so the loss is the attacker's net ETH gain (64.70728098661343541 ETH borrowed minus 54 ETH paid in), equal to the protocol's net ETH depletion because the swap and origination fees stayed with protocol fee recipients. Unrepaid debt is not added and the SPIRAL collateral left behind is not netted.

ageReset.description: Immutable hook runtime: spot-price collateral valuation and tx.origin-keyed same-block guard are code constants; owner launch steps (initializePool, seedBands, openTrading) set no defect-creating value.

sources.note: Anchor, root cause, first exercise. All attack txs are in block 25974146 (ts 1789370279): index 0 0xc8da348a... CREATE of attack contract 0x0c23c8bc3b7c565f3f9f4ac691a4dc4275086f86 by EOA 0x859e69a29244a10800a34ee66919426c02afa2f0, which funds six helper EOAs with 0.01 ETH each; index 1 source-7 (0x84f2f1d0..., selector 0x5705b581, value 54 ETH) buys through the SPIRAL/ETH V4 pool (PoolManager Swap 0x40e9cecb, poolId 0x66a3227d85b4780ba297af51659da9c382dd4c98a86c6085a1e1514cbd6a5696: amount0 -52.92 ETH, amount1 +141059.2413298695 SPIRAL; 1.08 ETH fee to feeCollector 0x3cca2bf5b1c06880c9d36eebe264b16a33530e11); indices 2..7 are six calls to the attack contract (selector 0x1242e326) from six distinct EOAs 0x863d23e2..., 0x8daf9567..., 0xf914eca7..., 0x02399536..., 0x4116d22f..., 0xf3e7add5..., each invoking hook borrow 0x0ecbcdab. Source-1 (index 2) is the first. Its callTracer tree: hook pulls 26194.701114956762 SPIRAL (transferFrom), reads PoolManager extsload (getSlot0), unlocks, DELEGATECALLs linked SpiralLibV2 0x64fa317a701ffdf19c34f8bcd58241aef343ff20 doBorrow, which removes band liquidity and takes 12.301514615574584162 ETH to the attack contract and 0.315423451681399593 ETH origination fee to spiralBuyback 0x7a9ca8f37da400d9b911510df62da1c2248d20fa. PositionOpened 0xdc8716bb (user = attack contract) logs entrySpotE18 1204149840447302 (0.0012041 ETH/SPIRAL) for all six borrows, versus 847894005737271 in the last pre-attack open (block 25955473). Source-5: borrow values collateral at live slot0 sqrtPrice (LDF.spiralValueInETH(sqrtP, collateral) * LTV_BPS 4000 / 10000) with no TWAP or deviation bound, and the only same-block defence, noSameBlockSwap/afterSwap, keys lastSwapBlockOf on tx.origin, so a pump by one EOA leaves other origins unfenced; the attack contract (constant msg.sender) passes it six times. Earliest exercise: Etherscan V2 logs.getLogs on the hook, blocks 0..99999999, returns 144 logs through block 25981345, 21 PositionOpened (topic 0xdc8716bba9101dcc80a43903e583e786955f425d332c0de3d72aa87584c82ac6). The 6 earlier kind-1 (BORROW) opens are at blocks 25949865, 25950048, 25950071, 25950083, 25960713, 25963311 with debt <= 2.2065 ETH; eth_getLogs PoolManager Swap for the poolId in each of those blocks finds no swap before the borrow's tx index that bought SPIRAL (only sells, amount0 > 0, at indices 53/86 in 25950071, none before index 14 in 25950083, a sell at 101 in 25960713). No PositionOpened occurs after block 25974146. Source-1 and the five later borrows in source-8 are the only borrows at a same-block pumped spot.

Verified source: Etherscan V2 contract.getsourcecode chainid=1 address 0x1725577dc9b1ee2d95db49c2193226471594aacc returns ContractName SpiralHookV2, compiler v0.8.26+commit.8a97fa7a, optimizer 1 run, standard-JSON including contracts/canonical_v2/SpiralHookV2.sol, SpiralStateV2.sol, SpiralLibV2.sol and contracts/LDF.sol. Inspect SpiralHookV2.borrow (uses poolManager.getSlot0(_poolId()) and LDF.spiralValueInETH for collateral value), SpiralStateV2 modifier noSameBlockSwap (lastSwapBlockOf[tx.origin]) and SpiralHookV2.afterSwap (writes lastSwapBlockOf[tx.origin]).

Loss, net. The hook-owned V4 liquidity pays borrowers; the attacker's own pump ETH entered the same liquidity, so gross victim depletion cannot be separated from the attacker's input. callTracer ETH value transfers in block 25974146: source-7 attack contract -> PoolManager 54 ETH, PoolManager -> feeCollector 1.08 ETH; source-1 and the source-8 set pay the attack contract 12301514615574584162 + 22397103346934662924 + 10934312370255774461 + 12116031358043034158 + 3656669934193414355 + 3301649361611965350 = 64707280986613435410 wei and pay spiralBuyback origination fees 315423451681399593 + 574284701203452895 + 280366983852712165 + 310667470719052157 + 93760767543420880 + 84657675938768342 = 1659161050938806032 wei; index 8 0xe8d33fdf... sweeps 64707280986613435410 wei from the attack contract to the attacker EOA. Hook-owned pool ETH: 52920000000000000000 - 64707280986613435410 - 1659161050938806032 = -13446442037552241442 wei, of which fees to the protocol's feeCollector and spiralBuyback stay with the protocol. Net protocol ETH loss = attacker net ETH gain = 64.70728098661343541 - 54 = 10.70728098661343541 ETH. The six positions (141059.24 SPIRAL collateral, 66.366442037552241 ETH debt per PositionOpened) were never repaid; the attacker's SPIRAL collateral left in the hook is not netted. Valued at source-9 WETH quote.

Identity and age. SpiralHookV2 0x1725577dc9b1ee2d95db49c2193226471594aacc is a direct, non-proxy hook (Etherscan Proxy 0), created by CREATE2 factory 0x4e59b44847b379578588920ca78fbf26c0b4956c in source-4 (block 25949176 index 145, ts 1789069643, sent by owner EOA 0xbbbde95f24ccc71c4f8fdb10a679d03b26598c19). eth_getCode empty at 25949175; keccak256 runtime (22648 bytes) 0xab71142d1a2408df0a6db9e8ea57a8a2682519944ba982557279a3dd0f2d4917 at 25949176, 25974145 and 26078000. owner and feeCollector are immutable; no upgrade or selfdestruct path. Etherscan account.txlist of the owner, blocks 25949000..25974146, has 13 calls to the hook: setSpiralBuyback 0x40b04ce1 (25949193), initializePool 0x250e6de0 (25949196), ten seedBands 0x33e87193 (25949197..25949235) and openTrading 0xc9567bf9 (0x2a3fb57e2f2c1cf0d7b1108daa31cfeedd57b083aa6231c5a0f70904f162fbc9, block 25949466). These launch steps seed the hook-owned curve and open trading for every function; none sets a value that creates the spot-pricing or tx.origin-guard defect, which are constants of the runtime (LTV_BPS constant 4000, getSlot0 read, lastSwapBlockOf[tx.origin]), so deployment is the age basis: 1789370279 - 1789069643 = 300636 s (3.48 days); openTrading would shorten it by 290 blocks (about 58 min). The linked SpiralLibV2 library executes the liquidity removal for the amount the hook computes and is not defect-bearing.
